<!--
  A closing call to action: a heading, one sentence and one or two links. Axes: layout (card, band, split
  picture, row: heading beside the button in a card), tone, actions (one, two, form: an email field), proof
  (none, quote), density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CtaQuote } from "./cta-band.types";
import type { ActionSet } from "../components/cta-actions.types";

export type CtaBandProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  actions: ActionSet;
  quote?: CtaQuote;
  layout?: "card" | "band" | "split" | "row" | "banner";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  proof?: "none" | "quote";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Card from "../primitives/card/card.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import CtaActions from "../components/cta-actions.vue";
import CtaBanner from "../blocks/cta-banner.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import QuoteProof from "../components/quote-proof.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  actions,
  quote,
  layout = "card",
  tone = "muted",
  proof = "none",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<CtaBandProps>();
const center = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "band") || ((layout as string) === "banner"));
</script>

<template>
  <CtaBanner
    v-if="((layout as string) === 'banner')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :text="text"
    :cta="actions.cta"
    :href="actions.href"
    :tone="tone"
  />
  <Block v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'row')"
    tag="section"
    class="py-8"
    :aria-labelledby="tpl('{0}-title', id)"
    data-testid="section"
    :data-tone="tone"
    :data-density="density"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" data-slot="container">
      <Card variant="muted">
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <Stack gap="2" class="min-w-0">
            <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="bold" :id="tpl('{0}-title', id)">
              {{ title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <QuoteProof
            v-if="((proof as string) === 'quote')"
            :quote="quote?.text"
            :quoteBy="quote?.by"
            :center="center"
          />
          <CtaActions :id="id" :actions="actions" :center="center" />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Container>
  </Block>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="text"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :align="(center ? 'center' : 'start')"
    :boxed="((layout as string) === 'card')"
    :media="{ show: ((layout as string) === 'split') }"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
  >
    <QuoteProof
      v-if="((proof as string) === 'quote')"
      :quote="quote?.text"
      :quoteBy="quote?.by"
      :center="center"
    />
    <CtaActions :id="id" :actions="actions" :center="center" />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
